links.outcome: ACP documentation by randomized physician after high-risk notification recommending ACP
links.effect: Intervention 34.7% vs control 19.6% (OR 2.04; 95% CI 1.16-3.59); no significant change in ACP documentation by any clinician (52.8% vs 42.8%, OR 1.31; 95% CI 0.81-2.13).
links.quote: Patients of physicians randomized to the intervention group were more likely to have a documented ACP conversation by the randomized physician compared to the control group (34.7% vs. 19.6%; OR 2.04; 95% CI 1.16-3.59).
